items.title: Land plants' closest algal relatives evolved multicellular growth repeatedly, genetic analysis suggests
items.summary: What did the algae that gave rise to the first land plants look like? A research team led by the University of Göttingen and including the universities of Maastricht and Innsbruck and Museo Nacional de Ciencias Naturales has now taken a detailed look at one of the most important groups for answering this question: the Zygnematophyceae, the closest living algal relatives of land plants. These include familiar-looking filamentous algae such as Spirogyra, as well as many that just consist of single cells. Despite their relatively simple appearance, they are particularly important for understanding plant evolution due to their close relationship with land plants.

items.title: Paired DNA strands recognize shape, not just sequence, in new small-molecule sensing method
items.summary: You have probably performed a sandwich assay before, even if you didn't know it. Sandwich assays are the molecular sensing technology behind lateral flow tests like the at-home COVID test. After a sample is dripped onto the test strip, it combines with detector antibodies attached to tiny gold particles, which bind to any viral proteins present. When the sample reaches the test line, a second antibody anchored to the strip binds to a different site on the viral protein, creating a molecular "sandwich." As the gold particles accumulate, the test line turns dark red, becoming visible to the naked eye.

Bogain and French politics editor Marc Perelman join Delano D'Souza to examine a protest movement that has evolved beyond its initial demands over purchasing power, fuel prices and education into a broader challenge to the French government. Perelman identifies a striking political paradox: Marine Le Pen and Jean-Luc Mélenchon, despite occupying opposing ideological positions, are “objective allies” in their shared electoral interest in weakening the political centre.

Her account reveals a deeper struggle over economic dignity, the future of public services and the democratic right to collective protest. “People just want to live, not survive.” For Martinez, deteriorating schools, insufficient salaries and the dismantling of public services are not isolated policy failures. They are interconnected symptoms of political and economic priorities that, in her assessment, place fiscal restraint above social welfare. Her demand for “a new budget” that is “not based on cuts” is accompanied by a call to “tax the biggest companies, the richest companies where the profits are made.”

MPs told it's crunch time for a decision on refurbishment amid warnings of a Notre Dame-style fire. More asbestos has been discovered in Parliament, the BBC has learnt, as MPs come under pressure to sign off on a major revamp of the crumbling home of UK democracy. Known asbestos items in the Palace of Westminster and wider parliamentary estate, such as insulation, roofing, floor tiles and ropes, now number more than 1,650 - an increase of 500 since 2021. Charles Porter, who produced Finding Faith, a 2025 film that starred starring Paula Patton, Loretta Devine and Keith David, has died. He was 47. Five of France's unions have joined a wave of strikes and protests in a national day of action. Hundreds of thousands of demonstrators are expected to take part in marches across France as five unions join strikes and protests in a national day of action. The protests began in September with high school students complaining about poor conditions and resources in education, but have spread to include the so-called "yellow vest" movement and workers. Discord is moving its apps fully over to the Rust programming language. Tom Warren Nov 5, 2026, 11:39 AM UTC Link Share Gift Illustration by Alex Castro / The Verge Tom Warren is a senior correspondent and author of Notepad , who has been covering all things Microsoft, PC, and tech for over 20 years. Discord is finally giving up on Electron, the cross-platform framework that lets developers build desktop apps using web technologies. Electron web apps are notoriously heavy on system resources, and Discord is now moving its desktop app fully to Rust — a modern programming language designed for speed and memory safety.

Democrats erased the GOP’s trifecta edge and gained new power over energy policy. That advantage has disappeared, clearing the path for more climate and clean energy legislation, according to analysts and advocates. Wong, 30, is among hundreds of Hongkongers detained under the controversial national security law. Joshua Wong, once the face of Hong Kong's democracy movement, has been sentenced to 10 years in jail for colluding with foreign forces under the city's sweeping national security law. Wong is among hundreds of campaigners and ordinary Hongkongers arrested under the law, which was imposed in 2020 following explosive pro-democracy protests against Beijing's growing control. Critics say the far-reaching law has silenced dissent, but authorities argue that it is needed to maintain stability and deny it has weakened the city's cherished autonomy.

Concacaf's new Gold Cup format will feature two groups of eight teams, with the change designed to create more meaningful matchups during the group stage. Previously played with four groups of four, the 2027 edition of the competition will have two groups of eight with teams sorted into "ranking bands." Teams will play four group matches instead of the previous three, with the top four teams in each group moving into the quarterfinals. The bands will separate teams into levels based on their Concacaf ranking. Teams will meet an opponent from each band, meaning the strongest team in a group will play a team from Band 2, Band 3 and Band 4.

The ocean’s blue and green hues near the infamous zone of debris have gotten brighter over the last 20 years, satellite data show The Great Pacific Garbage Patch , an area in the Pacific Ocean where debris naturally accumulates, is full of tiny bits of plastic. So full, in fact, that it seems to be changing the color of the ocean. The ocean is, of course, famously blue. That’s due to the wavelength of light it reflects . Water scatters shorter wavelengths, which we see as blue—while absorbing longer wavelengths such as red or orange. Additives in the ocean can affect its color, including phytoplankton, algae and sediment.

Using a capture card and open-source software to run PS5 video through a PC GPU. On an explicitly unmoderated GTAVI subreddit, user RevolutionaryBus8208 lays out a proposed setup, which runs a PS5 through a 4K capture card to a PC. From there, the video signal is run through Veyra , an open source tool that can apply DLSS 5’s AI-powered “neural rendering” to video content. The result—which also uses DLSS frame generation to increase the 30 fps source to a 90 fps output—is then piped back to a 4K TV, theoretically adding some of the benefits of a beefy PC graphics card to a console-exclusive game.

California has historically had the largest population of death row inmates in the US. California Governor Gavin Newsom has commuted the death sentences of all 548 people on death row in the state, changing them instead with life in prison. "We can now let these offenders die in obscurity while we forever remember and honour the victims," he said in a letter. The decision to spare death row inmates is largely symbolic in a state that has not executed a prisoner since 2006, though experts say it could save millions of dollars in court costs each year. Only 13 inmates have been killed since voters reinstated the death penalty in 1978.

Law bans social media platforms from providing minors features such as autoplay that lead to compulsive use Google, Meta and TikTok sued California to block enforcement of ⁠a new state law intended ⁠to limit the risk ​of addicting children under 16 to social media platforms. The law, known as Assembly Bill 1709, prohibits such platforms from offering underage children “psychologically exploitative features” that could lead to compulsive use, such as providing ⁠personal recommendations and sending videos through autoplay features. It also requires the deletion of children’s accounts with those features.
